tasks.description: Move the SO101 gripper frame above the box in scene_box and hold.
Trace a 4 cm square with the gripper frame above the box and return to start.
Open then close the SO101 gripper and report the observed gripper-joint motion.
Approach the box, make controlled contact, and leave the box within 5 cm of its reset XY position.
Move the gripper frame by a 5 cm Z offset, hold briefly, and return to the source home pose.
